title.narrative: Promoting the improvement of teachers’ status

description.narrative: Teachers who are well-trained, supported and valued are essential to ensuring quality education for all and meeting the education targets of the 2030 Agenda. For that reason, they are a top priority for UNESCO. In Ethiopia, the teachers who are in in-serve and in pre-service need quality training and continuously update to keep pace with changes in education. Most of the teachers are demotivated, that is why UNESCO liaison Office and the MoE will conduct case study on the status of teachers of primary schools to get the best figure of the teachers in the country for relevant actions in the future. This study aims to identify the levers to work on to increase the supply of qualified, motivated teachers by improving policies relating to them and supporting quality training which meets learners’ needs. Special focus is placed, inclusion, gender sensitivity and digital technologies.
